overview: At two you played Egeon. You open, and you are idle until the end. Across the water the Rose had Crack Me. You did not cross. The reckoning is at five, in the house.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Played Egeon, and did not cross the water.

assets.name: The Comedy of Errors
assets.disposition: Played Egeon and stayed for the reckoning

summary: Played Egeon and stayed for the reckoning
